original_content_full: The paper "Zero-Shot Video Moment Retrieval using BLIP-based Models" by Jobin Idiculla Wattasseril, Sumit Shekhar, Jürgen Döllner and Matthias Trapp was accepted for publication at the 18th International Symposium on Visual Computing (ISVC 2023). The conference will take place in Lake Tahoe, NV, USA from October 16th to 18th. For more information, visit the website.
